input.quote: Before engaging another provider, Customer must disclose and match for Vendor any more favourable commercial offer it receives.
input.rationale: The MFN runs the wrong way: Customer must disclose and match any more favourable third-party offer for Vendor's benefit, an open-ended obligation to extend better terms to Vendor. We deleted it and rely on Section 12.3's acknowledgement that Customer has made no most-favoured-customer commitment; MFN pricing granted to us would be welcome.

input.quote: Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
input.rationale: This is a one-way 24-month no-hire covering all Vendor employees and expressly capturing people who apply on their own initiative — our walk-away position. We narrowed it to our fallback: mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from the end of their involvement, with carve-outs for general advertising and unsolicited approaches, and no "hire or employ" prohibition.
